thread:
acme_support: Heads up — our payment endpoint started returning weird chars in invoice summaries after a regional failover. Also saw 503s then success with garbled text. request-id=xw-4421. Billing jumped from retries.

alex: On it. Quick look at router logs shows a failover from eu-west -> eu-south and the served variant was `redwood-large-lite-q` instead of the requested `redwood-large-v1`. That variant uses a different tokenizer family, explains garbling/truncation.

alex: sample request they sent:
```
POST /v1/generate
Host: api.redwood.ai
Authorization: Bearer ****
X-Region: eu-west
X-Request-Id: xw-4421
{"model":"redwood-large-v1","input":"Summarize invoice INV-2026-09 for AcmePay"}
```

alex: raw response (from customer):
```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json
{"id":"resp_X","model":"redwood-large-lite-q","completion":"\u00A0Invoice total:\n\uFFFD 0\u0120\u0120100"}
```

maria: Yikes. Can you paste the full response body + retry timestamps? We need to quantify the billing impact before offering credits.

alex: They retried ~8 times within ~2m after seeing 503s. I have the stacktrace and router excerpt. Pasted them to the thread.

sahil: Routing logs show at 2026-03-16T14:12:03Z eu-west cluster hit soft capacity. Fallback policy triggered. New selector prioritizes labels cost-tier then compatibility; because of that it picked `redwood-large-lite-q` (cheaper) despite tokenizer_hash mismatch.

sahil: Previously we enforced tokenizer_hash equality for any fallback when model session state mattered. The selector change from last week inverted label precedence; regression.

maria: That's the regression I feared. For stateful use (invoices, chat, embeddings) we must never fallback to a tokenizer-variant with different vocab. Add a hard compatibility gate.

raj: I'll revert the precedence change and add selector.enforce_tokenizer_match=true. Preparing patch now. Will run through staging and canary. Expect canary in ~30-45m if staging green.

infra-bot: deploy pipeline queued: selector-tokenizer-fix -> staging -> canary(10%) -> prod. Note: two flaky unit tests flagged in variant_label_test. CI must be fixed before canary.

raj: Fix incoming for label namespace collision. Pushing small patch to tests now.

maria: Immediate mitigation for AcmePay — options:
- Force-route them to eu-central (has spare capacity) via tenant override
- Pin account to model-version redwood-large-v1 (disable fallback)
- Temporarily disable fallback for invoicing endpoints

alex: I asked customer which they prefer. I recommended force-route + credit for retry charges.

acme_support: Force-route sounds good, do it please. We need correct outputs ASAP.

alex: Applied per-tenant override to route to eu-central. Please validate.

acme_support: Confirmed — responses looked normal immediately. Garbling stopped. Thanks.

priya: Opened billing ticket BILL-1987 to estimate credit for retry charges. Will calculate token counts once we ingest logs.

sahil: Repro steps for platform folks (staging):
1) saturate eu-west with load: `./tools/loadgen --region eu-west --qps 1800 --model redwood-large-v1`
2) watch router decisions: `kubectl logs router | rg "fallback selected"`
3) fetch sample response: `jq .model out.json`

sahil: Quick shell repro (staging):
```
for i in $(seq 1 400); do
  curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "X-Region: eu-west" \
    -d '{"model":"redwood-large-v1","input":"ping"}' https://staging.api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -o r$i.json &
  (( i % 50 == 0 )) && sleep 1
done
```

maria: After deploy, add a monitor: fire if selected_fallback.tokenizer_hash != primary.tokenizer_hash -> alert `fallback_tokenizer_delta` and page on P1 for stateful tenants.

sahil: Adding rule now. Also creating a report to identify other tenants who experienced similar swaps in last 7 days.

raj: Staging tests passing after fix. Starting canary(10%) in 25m. Will watch for any unexpected model variants being selected.

priya: Once we have exact retry/token numbers, I'll coordinate credits and AM outreach.

alex: Customer confirmed force-route fixed output quality. Closing loop once patch is in prod and billing credit issued.

maria: Postmortem assignments: tech lead = raj, customer comms = alex, billing = priya. We'll follow up with timeline and RCA.

alex: Thanks all. Adding postmortem doc and links to this thread. :white_check_mark:
